description: Free. Before writing code against a library you may know only from older training data, check whether it changed since that version: verdict, major versions crossed, how many breaking changes, deprecations and security fixes, and the top three breaking headlines. Call upgrade_check (paid) for the full details with evidence.

package.description: Package name or source id, e.g. next, @anthropic-ai/sdk, node. Prefix with npm: or pypi: when a name exists in both registries (pypi:openai vs npm:openai); bare names that match more than one tracked package return 400 ambiguous_package (not charged).
